name: Until We Meet Again
source:
"Until We Meet Again" is a short fairy tale-esque visual novel based on the classic story 'Snow White' , where you unceremoniously fell off your horse and found yourself stranded in the middle of the woods. Fortunately, a kind stranger (who looks suspiciously similar to the man in your dreams) has taken pity on you and now you're spending the night in his cottage. While you're glad that you don't have to sleep outside, there's something strange about him..

"Why does he know your name? You never told him."

"He's awfully nice to you, have you two met before?"

"You know something like that has never happened, so why is he talking like it did?"

[From [url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/until-we-meet-again]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《直到我们再次相遇》是一部童话风格的短篇视觉小说，改编自经典故事《白雪公主》，在故事中，你不客气地从马背上摔下来，发现自己被困在树林中央。幸运的是，一个善良的陌生人（他看起来与你梦中的那个人非常相似）同情你，现在你在他的小屋里过夜。虽然你很高兴不用睡在外面，但他有些奇怪……

“他为什么知道你的名字？你从来没有告诉过他。”

“他对你很好，你们两个以前见过吗？”

“你知道这样的事情从来没有发生过，那他为什么要这样说话呢？”

[来自[url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/until-we-meet-again]itch.io[/url]]
